title: Attributable sensor event data
description: Motion/door/sensor events written to the local event log can be attributed to specific individuals or users, potentially preventing them from denying certain claims about their activities.
assumptions: Assumes sensor events are associated with specific users or individuals.

title: Potentially sensitive data collection
description: Motion and sensor events may include sensitive personal data (e.g., location, behavior patterns) that should only be collected when strictly required for the system's functional purpose.
assumptions: Assumes the system may collect more sensitive data than functionally required.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain without more context on what specific data types are collected in the sensor events.

title: Excessive data volume
description: The local event log may process an excessive amount of personal data beyond what is functionally needed for the home hub's operation.
assumptions: Assumes the system may store more data than necessary.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain without more context on data retention policies and what data is actually stored.

title: Excessive data sharing with third party
description: Aggregated device-usage analytics are shared with an external analytics vendor (EE3) which may be more parties than functionally necessary for the mobile app's core functionality.
assumptions: Assumes the analytics vendor is a predetermined, known party, but the functional necessity of sharing with this specific vendor is not clearly defined.

title: Data propagation to external service
description: Personal data is propagated to an external analytics vendor service where it may be used beyond the original mobile app's functional scope.
assumptions: Assumes the analytics vendor may use the data for purposes beyond what the mobile app intended.

title: Potentially sensitive data type
description: Device-usage analytics may include sensitive information about user behavior patterns that could be perceived as highly sensitive depending on the context.
assumptions: Assumes device-usage analytics could include sensitive behavioral patterns.

title: Unawareness of data sharing
description: Data subjects may not be aware that their device-usage analytics are being shared with external analytics vendors.
assumptions: Assumes users may not have explicit knowledge of third-party analytics sharing.

title: Potential violation of data minimization
description: Aggregated device-usage analytics may include more personal data than is actually needed for the mobile app's stated functionality.
assumptions: Assumes the analytics collection exceeds functional requirements.

title: Potential insufficient data subject controls
description: Users may lack control over whether their device-usage analytics are shared with external analytics vendors.
assumptions: Assumes users cannot opt-out or control analytics sharing.

title: Sensitive video data type
description: Video data may contain highly sensitive personal information (e.g., home footage, private activities) that should only be processed when strictly required.

title: Fine-grained video data disclosure
description: Video data may be of a more fine-grained level of granularity than needed for the playback functionality.

title: Data propagation to backend
description: Video data is propagated from cloud storage to mobile app backend where it may be accessible by more parties than functionally needed.

title: Excessive party access to video data
description: Video data may be made accessible to more parties than functionally necessary during the retrieval process.

title: Excessive video data volume
description: The volume of video data processed by the mobile app backend may exceed what is functionally needed for playback.

title: Implicit data disclosure during playback
description: Video data may be implicitly disclosed as a side-effect of the playback functionality.

title: Data subject unawareness of storage
description: Homeowner may not be aware that their video data is being stored in cloud storage and retrieved by the mobile app backend.

title: Lack of data subject control over video data
description: Homeowner may lack control to set preferences or consent in how their video data is processed and stored.

title: Violation of data minimization principle
description: More personal data (video) is processed than is actually needed for the playback functionality.

title: Violation of storage limitation principle
description: Video data may be stored longer than functionally needed for the playback functionality.
